dataset: Tawam CKD cohort, Al-Shamsi et al., PLoS ONE 13(6): e0199920 (2018), S2 data (CC BY 4.0)
question: does the slow clock rank who reaches eGFR < 60 sooner? (ranking, not a personal-slope test)

kfre.note: not applicable: every baseline eGFR is >= 60 and the data have no UACR (KFRE needs eGFR 10-59 with a UACR)

method: score = median years to eGFR < 60 from the slow clock (baseline eGFR as the only observation, registry slope prior by diabetes status, AKI penalty not applied); '> 15 years' tie at the top. Harrell's C (lifelines) against TimeToEventMonths / EventCKD35; patient-level bootstrap (1000) percentile CIs. No parameter was changed for or after this check.
